messages:
sophia: Heads-up: Billing noticed several invoices where Console attributes requests to project=devops-scripts but token introspect reports project=partner-oak. looks like our UI/quotas are using the X-Project header in some paths
liam: i dug into traces. legacy partners hit the proxy which still injects X-Project. downstream services (Console + quota) currently prefer that header for display/enforcement
arjun: that was a compat decision historically. after the router consolidation the behavior got preserved but it causes misattribution when tokens actually carry a validated `project` claim
sophia: real fallout: wrong quota billing, cost dashboards mis-tagged, and feature gates firing for the wrong tenant. we should make a canonical source of truth
liam: proposal: canonicalize attribution to validated token claim `project` when present. fallback order: token.claim.project -> org_compat_override -> X-Project header -> anonymous_project
arjun: add telemetry first: metric `project_attrib_source` (tag: source:introspect|header|none) and counter `project_attrib_mismatch_total` when header!=claim. also sample 1/sec/org traces for mismatches so we can audit integrators
sophia: Console UX: in request inspector show "Attribution: token claim (validated)" or "Attribution: header (legacy)". when mismatch show a subtle info-pill "possible mismatch" linking to migration docs, not a loud error
liam: we need an org-level toggle `allow_legacy_header_attrib` for partners who rely on header-first behavior. default OFF for new orgs, keep ON for existing orgs to avoid breakage
arjun: implementation: auth-exchange will stamp X-Effective-Project earlier. introduce FF `attrib_claims_first` so we can enable per-cluster/canary and a per-org compatibility flag for whitelisted orgs
sophia: rollout plan: 1) add metrics + dashboards; 2) unit + integration tests; 3) behind feature-flag; 4) canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with 48h observation windows
liam: alerting: if `project_attrib_mismatch_total` rate >5x baseline OR any single project's quota burn delta >20%/hour during canary, roll back immediately. add a quiet daily top-20 mismatch digest for billing and PMs
billing-oncall: we can monitor billing signals. ping 24h before canary and share runbook & email templates for affected org admins
arjun: BC/comms: automated email template + migration doc showing how to mint tokens with `project` claim and examples to stop relying on headers. recommend 90-day deprecation before changing defaults for pre-existing orgs
sophia: timeline estimate: auth-exchange PR + unit tests 1d, metrics+dashboards 0.5d, Console toggle + help copy 1d, runbook+comms 0.5d. target deploy next Tue if no blockers
liam: i'll coordinate with SRE for canary windows and add SLO/billing alarms to the release playbook. will post plan in #release-war-room and link INF-9982
sophia: created INF-9982 to track: "Canonicalize project attribution to token claims, add telemetry, org compatibility toggle"
auth-deploy-bot: Created INF-9982: "Canonicalize project attribution to token claims" assigned to arjun, sophia
billing-oncall: please include the alert thresholds and the runbook steps in INF-9982. we'll standby during the canary period
arjun: will add the feature-flag wiring, per-cluster FF toggles for quick rollback, and unit tests asserting precedence semantics. will link PR/CI here once ready
sophia: keep this thread for summary; move infra/PR links into INF-9982. thanks team
liam: thanks all. any objections to the plan? none heard -> proceeding
arjun: opening PR now, will add screenshots for Console inspector change and attach dashboard links
sophia: appreciate the quick turnaround. let's be careful on alerts so we can spot subtle quota shifts early
liam: agreed. i will schedule a 1h canary watch with SRE & Billing on call for the rollout window
sophia: end of thread.
